chunks.text: Beware, the doctors lie to you at this clinic. I recently went down for 3 weeks of treatment for breast cancer. It makes me question everything they are administering here. It has been extremely stressful which is opposite from what I need healing cancer. I am guessing they push chemo so much because they want results. I later found out the type of cancer I have, isn't responsive to chemotherapy. I would have hoped a clinic like this would have tests to check this. The total disrespect for me to make an informed decision makes me motivated to share my story to help protect others. I regret going here. Spend your money with doctors who are honest. I will say that the nurses were spectacular. They deserve a 10 star rating.
